tradition_assertions.notes: The Church's English canon list names Genesis. This historical edition is not claimed to be the current official printed edition.

witness.title: August Dillmann (ed.), Veteris Testamenti Aethiopici Tomus Primus, sive Octateuchus Aethiopicus
witness.repository_or_publisher: Leipzig edition; digital transcription by Ran HaCohen
witness.editorial_policy: Historical critical edition transcription; Dillmann's critical apparatus is not included in the digitized text.

coverage.numbering_policy: Preserve published labels, including discontinuities; no renumbering or cross-witness equivalence is implied.
